A disciplined, evidence-focused portfolio for technical leaders connecting architecture decisions to business outcomes.

### 4. About — Sound judgment. Shared ownership.

I’m Amara, a technical leader who believes that a good strategy is clear enough to act on and honest enough to revise. My work connects executive priorities with the realities of systems, teams, and delivery.

I bring a calm outside perspective, make the tradeoffs explicit, and leave organizations with stronger internal capability — not a permanent dependency on a consultant.
